name: Keith Carr
story: Keith Carr wrote The Implementation of GIS in New Zealand for the 1988 ESCAP workshop report. His contemporary account described the established New Zealand Land Resource Inventory, purpose-built vector GIS and the wider use of spatial technology. The paper provides a record of how a New Zealand practitioner described the field before the 1989 Wellington GIS conference.

Keith Carr’s 1988 ESCAP workshop paper “The Implementation of GIS in New Zealand” described an existing national resource database, digital cadastral work, remote-sensing activity and growing use of commercial systems. Carr used the term GIS for this work before the 1989 Wellington conference.
